49471c30fd364b80.title: Patrick Droney
49471c30fd364b80.desc: "I like to keep coming back to places that don't change," Patrick Droney says, sitting at the Bowery Hotel in the Lower East Side. "It's how I notice how much I have." He's been returning here for years, through one chapter and the next — a fixed point to measure against. It's a fitting place to talk about his third album, Made You Look, out July 24 on Warner Records. He made it after three defining years away — a meaningful pause in a career that spans three acclaimed records (2018’s self-titled EP, 2021’s State of the Heart, and 2023’s Subtitles for Feelings), appearances on late night TV (Seth Meyers, Colbert), and hundreds of millions of streams. In the interval between projects, his life changed in more ways than one — above all, he became a father, and arrived somewhere no familiar room could prepare him for. Made You Look is an instruction and an admission at once — a record about attention, and how rarely we manage to give it. In a culture built for speed, he slowed down, and the music is braver for it, both sonically and emotionally. “In a stretch of life that is blurry, attention is the easiest thing to lose. I tried to pay more of it instead.” The record is intimate…

4984963360ec447d.title: BEAT: Belew/Vai/Levin/Bozzio Performing the Music of KING CRIMSON
4984963360ec447d.desc: Doors: 6:30PM Show: 8PM *All times are subject to change Ages 3+ welcome. Everyone requires a ticket regardless of age. The balcony is only accessible by stairs. Following more than 100 acclaimed performances across North and South America, Europe, and Japan, BEAT returns this fall for the last North American tour. Former King Crimson members Adrian Belew and Tony Levin are joined by guitar virtuoso Steve Vai and legendary drummer Terry Bozzio to perform the music of the three landmark 1980s King Crimson albums - Discipline, Beat, and Three of a Perfect Pair. Rather than attempting to recreate the original recordings, BEAT brings this extraordinary music to life with the spirit, precision, and adventurousness that made it so enduring. Whether you've lived with these albums for decades or are discovering them for the first time, this is the final opportunity to experience one of progressive music's most celebrated catalogs performed by four of the best musicians on the planet Doors: 6:30PM Show: 8PM *All times are subject to change Ages 3+ welcome. Everyone requires a ticket regardless of age. The balcony is only accessible by stairs.
